reviewScope.summary: Reviewed the final corrections on GitHub master 2c1201930b403e4c081de212ca59ae9ca9a2f067, including the preserved PR #90 account and sync paths, explicit Guild operations and narrow Home layout.
evidence: 97 focused Vitest cases and 6 bundle-budget cases passed. Changed-file formatting and ESLint, TypeScript and circular dependency checks passed.

14 targeted managed browser cases passed. The revised Guild test passed on its own after the delayed-response fixture was made TypeScript-compatible. The default browser coverage includes offline, strict provider traffic counts, the 320px full Home text-line check, visual styles, keyboard access and Guild permissions.

Both existing PR #90 browser cases passed with sync enabled, covering registration and recovery, two-device sync, offline replay, conflicts and account isolation. The sync implementation and its provider contract match master.

The existing Guild SQL probe passed in disposable PostgreSQL/PGlite. Production builds passed their bundle budgets with sync disabled (457948 bytes JS gzip; 343107 bytes largest raw JS) and enabled (457654; 342903).

adversarialFindings.description: A test of the action and info-button boxes could pass when the Teknologioppslag label wrapped inside its button.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The common narrow layout gives the link more inline space. The existing full Home browser case counts rendered text lines at 320 CSS pixels, checks label containment and preserves the information button's hit area.

adversarialFindings.description: The Guild overview lacked a member list and a visual goal indicator. A full bar alone would hide contributions beyond the goal.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The existing member and ranking projections drive separate compact lists. The existing progress bar shows goal completion and the accompanying text keeps the actual total. Browser checks cover vertical members, ties and an exceeded goal.

adversarialFindings.description: The HUD queried Nhost on shell load and displayed data from a passive membership lookup.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The shell presents a name confirmed by an explicit Guild action and clears account-scoped state on identity changes. The existing command cancellation and session-pinning checks guard delayed replies. Browser checks exercise logout, another account, an old reply and exact provider traffic counts.

retrospective.summary: The local evidence applies to this payload. Hosted Final candidate certification and live Hasura/JWT and Guild migration validation are pending in their authorized environments. Vercel production alias was observed at 61bcb593.
